opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Scheme (A) up to £200; Scheme (B) up to £500 (Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored up to £750); Scheme (C) up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members. Scheme (A): undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes (B) & (C): PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics. Three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: quarterly, at midnight on 15th February, May, August and November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society, as long as studying or working in the UK, or the course is held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: quarterly, at midnight on 1st February, May, August, November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society, as long as studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project, funded by income from the Society's journal Heredity. Research should produce results suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend a Society meeting or event, used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Several levels of sponsorship; a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session up to about £1,000, major sponsorship of an entire meeting potentially several thousand pounds (major sponsorship levels in last 12 months between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, used towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: two deadlines per year (1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually. Funding may cover eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings.
